exact.description: Exact match on chunk id or symbol name.

keyword.description: Token overlap match over kb chunk tags/summary.

semantic.description: Placeholder for embedding similarity; falls back to keyword until an embedding provider is wired in kb_store.py.

symbol.description: Symbol index lookup by name/tag/namespace. Returns file+line only, never content.

log_failure.description: Extract only ERROR/FATAL lines from the failures cache. Never reads raw log.
